extensionDescription.message: Privacy-first local warnings for long ChatGPT conversations on Chrome and Edge.

baselineHint.message: Open a complete old chat or the current chat, then scan it to establish a reference baseline.

riskAdviceLong.message: This chat is getting long. Consider organizing important context.

riskAdviceOrganize.message: Prepare to continue in a new chat soon.

riskAdviceHigh.message: Continue in a new chat now.

limitQuestion.message: Did this chat reach the limit?

consentLocalRead.message: Reads visible ChatGPT content locally to estimate long-chat risk.

consentNoRawPersist.message: Does not save raw chat text.

consentDeleteLocal.message: Uninstall or clear extension data to remove local data.

continuationPrompt.message: Create a continuation package for a new ChatGPT chat so work can resume without re-analysis. Do not merely retell the conversation and do not invent missing facts. Structure the output as: 1) Current goal and exact stage; 2) Completed work that should not be repeated; 3) Confirmed decisions, tradeoffs, and reasons; 4) Important constraints, user preferences, privacy/safety requirements, compatibility limits, and things not to do; 5) Key working state, including relevant files, paths, repositories/branches/commits, code/configuration, data, platform/account status, versions, URLs, commands, and exact UI copy when they matter; 6) Unresolved issues, known defects, failed attempts, and why they failed; 7) Next actions in priority order, beginning with the first concrete action for the new chat; 8) Risks and pitfalls that could cause duplicated work, data loss, incorrect publishing, rollback, or regressions; 9) Essential verbatim material only when exact wording matters, such as commands, errors, copy, API names, filenames, or IDs. Clearly separate confirmed facts from inference and items that still need verification. Preserve exact names, versions, paths, commit hashes, URLs, and important values. Remove greetings and irrelevant process details, but do not omit context that would change the next action. If code or files are involved, state what was changed, what was tested, what was committed/pushed/published, and what remains uncommitted or pending. Finish with a short 'Continue execution' instruction that tells the new chat to read the package first, preserve the confirmed decisions and constraints, and continue from the listed next action instead of starting over.

toastRelearned.message: Existing baseline kept while recalibration starts

toastFailureIgnored.message: Current baseline kept; this chat was not used as a limit sample

toastNoConversation.message: Chat is open, but its conversation information is not available yet. Refresh and try again.

toastScanConfirm.message: Scan complete. A usable baseline is ready. If this chat hit the length limit, confirm it below.

toastScanAttachments.message: Scan complete. Current progress was refreshed; attachment data is handled conservatively.

toastScanRoleUncertain.message: Scan complete. Current progress was refreshed with conservative handling for uncertain roles.

toastBaselineReady.message: Reference baseline established. Risk tracking is ready.

toastBaselineNotSet.message: Scan finished, but this chat was not reliable enough to establish a baseline. Try another complete chat.

toastLimitDetected.message: Conversation-length limit detected. The limit baseline was confirmed automatically.

toastLimitConfirm.message: Scan complete. Please confirm that this chat really reached the conversation-length limit.

toastLimitAlreadyConfirmed.message: A confirmed limit baseline already exists.

toastScanFailed.message: Full scan did not finish. Please try again later.

scanNoScroll.message: Conversation scroll area was not found. Refresh and try again.

scanNoMessages.message: No conversation messages are available yet. Wait for the page to finish loading.

scanHeadLoading.message: Older messages are still loading. Wait a few seconds and try again.

scanTailChanging.message: The end of the conversation is still changing. Wait for the page to settle.

scanAlignmentFailed.message: Part of the history could not be read continuously, so the scan was stopped to avoid a misleading estimate.

scanLimitReached.message: This chat is very long and the scan did not finish. Try once more.

scanIncomplete.message: Complete history was not confirmed, so this scan will not establish or update the baseline.
